title: Aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Fuselage -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='34' ry='12' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- Fuselage highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='51' rx='30' ry='7' fill='#81D4FA'/>
  <!-- Wing top -->
  <polygon points='44,48 56,48 50,30 38,30' fill='#FF8A65'/>
  <!-- Wing top highlight -->
  <polygon points='44,46 56,46 50,33 41,33' fill='#FFAB91'/>
  <!-- Wing bottom -->
  <polygon points='42,62 58,62 64,76 36,76' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <!-- Wing bottom highlight -->
  <polygon points='44,64 56,64 60,73 40,73' fill='#FF8A65'/>
  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <polygon points='80,48 88,36 88,48' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <!-- Tail fin highlight -->
  <polygon points='81,47 86,39 86,47' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <!-- Tail wing -->
  <polygon points='76,55 90,55 90,60 76,60' fill='#FFCA28'/>
  <!-- Cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='52' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#B3E5FC'/>
  <!-- Cockpit shine -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='51' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#E1F5FE'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='55' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#29B6F6'/>
  <!-- Propeller hub -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#FFF176'/>
  <!-- Propeller blade top -->
  <rect x='11' y='46' width='2' height='9' rx='1' fill='#FFF59D'/>
  <!-- Propeller blade bottom -->
  <rect x='11' y='57' width='2' height='9' rx='1' fill='#FFF59D'/>
  <!-- Window dots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#B3E5FC'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#B3E5FC'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#B3E5FC'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#B3E5FC'/>
  <!-- Smile on fuselage -->
  <path d='M46 59 Q50 62 54 59' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='57' r='1.5' fill='#B3E5FC'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='57' r='1.5' fill='#B3E5FC'/>
</svg>
